name: Tokurun!
source:
In a their mischief, Tokumei and Valerie find themselves in a series of unexpected events that spiral out of control. Their antics, lead them to confront Tokumei’s most formidable adversary to date.

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3381726394]Steam Workshop[/url]]

Made for Snoot Jam 3.
translation:
在他们的恶作剧中，德明和瓦莱丽发现自己陷入了一系列失控的意外事件之中。他们的滑稽动作引导他们面对德明迄今为止最强大的对手。
